project_name: AI Systems Architect Accelerator Sponsor Dashboard
descriptor: A self-service dashboard for corporate L&D managers to enroll teams in the AI Systems Architect Accelerator, manage enrollments, and ensure exactly-once payment provisioning.

requirements.statement: The system must provide a dashboard at /sponsor/dashboard for corporate buyers to manage team enrollments.
The system must allow managers to add employees by name and email to a roster.
The system must integrate with PaySimple for payment processing at $1,788 per seat per year.
The system must send a magic link to managers for dashboard access without a password.
The system must provision employees and send magic-link invites atomically upon payment confirmation.
The system must track seats used vs free and employee progress through the course.
The system must allow seat transfers between employees.
The system must ensure exactly-once processing of PaySimple webhooks to prevent double-provisioning.
The system must provide a management view for Colaberry ops to see sponsor purchases without database access.
The system must support an optional 'enroll me too' checkbox for managers.
The system must connect to Postgres for Enrollment, Cohort, and ProgramBlueprint data.
The system must use Mandrill for sending magic-link and welcome emails.
The system must provide a user-friendly interface for non-technical L&D managers.
The system must handle PaySimple webhook retries gracefully to avoid duplicate actions.
The system must log all enrollment and payment actions for auditing purposes.
The system must allow managers to add more seats as needed.
The system must provide real-time updates on enrollment status and payment confirmations.
The system must ensure data privacy and security in compliance with relevant regulations.

## What we're building
AI Systems Architect Accelerator Sponsor Dashboard - A self-service dashboard for corporate L&D managers to enroll teams in the AI Systems Architect Accelerator, manage enrollments, and ensure exactly-once payment provisioning.
You are in Release r0 - Initial Skeleton (weeks 1-1).
This release lands when: Manager logs in via magic link, accesses dashboard, and adds employees to a roster.

## Your task
STORY-001 - Manager accesses dashboard via magic link
As a corporate L&D manager, I want to access the dashboard via a magic link, so that I can manage enrollments without a password.
Owning agent(s): Frontend Developer

## The requirement this satisfies
REQ-001 (FUNC, must) - "The system must provide a dashboard at /sponsor/dashboard for corporate buyers to manage team enrollments."
REQ-004 (FUNC, must) - "The system must send a magic link to managers for dashboard access without a password."

## How we build here
Implement the magic link authentication using Mandrill for email delivery. Ensure the dashboard is accessible only via the magic link and log all access attempts for auditing.
We build the walking skeleton first, then harden it. Work in small, testable, reversible steps. Every external call gets an explicit timeout and capped retries. Every side effect is idempotent - running it twice must produce the same end state, with no duplicate emails, rows, or charges.

## Failure paths you must handle
- Magic link expired
- Email delivery failure
- Unauthorized access attempt

## Acceptance - your stop condition
- Given a manager receives a magic link, when they click it, then they access the dashboard without a password.
- Given the dashboard loads, when the manager is not authenticated, then they are redirected to a magic link request page.
- Trust - All access attempts are logged with timestamps and IP addresses.

When every line above passes, the task is done - stop the build loop and show me the demo.

- Tests cover the happy path AND at least one failure path from the list above.
- Typecheck passes and no secrets are introduced.
- A junior developer can read the change and understand why it is correct.
- The acceptance criteria above are demonstrably met, not asserted.
